title: Contextual Contamination and Cognitive Inertia in Multimodal AI

contributions.purpose: 揭示多模态AI对解剖学不可能图像缺乏常识识别
contributions.mechanism: 用4个前沿多模态模型描述标准/反常/不可能医学图像
contributions.evaluation: 定性:标准图像描述准确,但对全部不可能图像无一识别其不合理,均按正常解剖描述
contributions.source_quote: none of the models recognized the inherent impossibility of the images. Instead, all models treated these implausible images as if they depicted anatomically plausible structures

contributions.purpose: 提出并演示'情境污染/认知惯性'层级错误机制
contributions.mechanism: 抽象六线图单独呈现 vs 与六指手emoji并列呈现,对比线数计数
contributions.evaluation: 定性:单独时正确数出6条线,配手图后同一图被误报为5条(受'手=五指'先验主导)
contributions.source_quote: when the identical image was shown alongside the abnormal hand emoji, the AI incorrectly reported five lines. This demonstrates how a powerful semantic context (in this case, "hand = five") can hierarchically dominate and contaminate the processing of visual information

contributions.purpose: 论证该结构性局限无法由prompt工程等用户级手段解决
contributions.mechanism: 概念性论证,主张需人类批判性思维与监督互补
contributions.evaluation: 定性主张:此为current medical AI的结构性限制,须保留人类临床监督
contributions.source_quote: These findings reveal a fundamental structural limitation in current medical AI systems that cannot be overcome by prompt engineering or other user-level adjustments alone.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This study extends beyond the known issue of AI's anatomical common-sense deficits by exploring a "hierarchical error" mechanism wherein one dominant context distorts the interpretation of adjacent, logically unrelated information.

notes: 定性简报,作者自认无正式假设检验、无统计分析(checklist Q7/Q8=NA);evaluation全为定性,符合定性研究口径但极单薄。数据红旗:样本极小(7单图+6对+1合成montage),每模型memory reset后单次提问(n=1),证据全为模型输出文本/截图,无量化图表基础。AI披露:human authors自认'lack any knowledge in computer science',假设[A]、实验设计[B](人提想法AI验证)、写作[C](大量用AI翻译)。desk-reject级低质量文,无编号贡献列表,由abstract+conclusion归纳。
